entities.description: A large, white, multi-story building with classical architectural features, including tall rectangular windows with white frames, decorative cornices, and a black wrought-iron balcony railing. The facade is smooth and painted white, with a prominent entrance featuring a fanlight window above a wooden door, flanked by white columns. The building appears to be a grand residence or townhouse, likely in a European city, given the style and the presence of a tree with yellow autumn leaves in the foreground.

attributes.cornice: decorative, white, above windows and roofline
attributes.foreground_element: tree with yellow autumn leaves, partially obscuring left side of building

entities.description: Two young men with curly brown hair are smiling at the camera; the man in the foreground is seated in a wheelchair wearing a red knit sweater, while the man in the background stands behind him in a dark blue suit with a white shirt and tie, placing his hands on the seated man's shoulders.

A young man with curly brown hair sits in a wheelchair, wearing a bright red crew-neck sweater, light blue jeans, and dark sneakers with white soles. He is smiling broadly, looking slightly to his left, with a person in a dark blue suit standing behind him with hands on his shoulders.

A close-up view of a person's lower legs and feet seated in a wheelchair, positioned on an asphalt surface scattered with yellow fallen leaves. The person is wearing blue jeans and black sneakers with white soles, resting on the wheelchair's footrests.

surface.details: scattered yellow fallen leaves, white painted line

attributes.position: seated in wheelchair, feet on footrests

entities.description: A tree with a thick, mottled gray and brown trunk and branches extending upward, covered in vibrant yellow autumn leaves. The leaves are star-shaped with pointed lobes, densely clustered on the branches, and some are falling or hanging loosely. The tree is positioned in front of a white building with large windows and black wrought-iron balconies.

attributes.background_context: white building with windows and black iron balconies

entities.description: A silver minivan is parked on a street with its sliding side door open, revealing a dark interior. The vehicle features chrome door handles, a chrome side mirror, and multi-spoke alloy wheels. The body has a smooth, metallic finish with reflections of trees and a building visible on the side panels.

attributes.reflections: trees and building visible on side panels

entities.description: A person wearing a red sweater and blue jeans is seated in a manual wheelchair with large spoked rear wheels and smaller front casters. The wheelchair has a black seat and backrest, silver metal frame, and black footrests, positioned on a paved surface with scattered leaves.
